spec_match.rationale: Correctly contrasts alpha()'s origin-space preservation with rgb(from …)'s conversion to sRGB coordinates, and explicitly refuses to infer visible gamut clipping from unequal serializations — matching the spec's actual claims.

interactive.rationale: Five origin buttons and the k slider drive both columns; verified live that the rgb(from …) column computes color(srgb 1.00689 -0.0639 …/0.5) for the oklch origin while the alpha() column shows an honest 'unavailable' hatch instead of a fake.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The blurb promises the two-way fade with computed values showing the space distinction and no overclaimed clipping — exactly what renders.

edge_cases.rationale: Per-column unsupported states, the same-string-for-sRGB-origins caveat, wide-gamut origins (display-p3, oklch, lab), and a three-way verdict line are all covered.

references.rationale: ChromeStatus 5070160203481088 (verified) and the css-color-5 relative-alpha anchor are linked.

conformance.rationale: The shared suite proves the real contract including display-p3 space preservation; its failures in this Chromium 141 session are environment-expected (alpha() unshipped here).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI: unsupported-left/live-right split verified with screenshots, DOM, and out-of-gamut computed read-back; console clean (fonts.googleapis.com failure environmental); native alpha() branch unreachable and controls not driven.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover both-evaluated and unsupported-labelled states, plus injected global error capture.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout, origin buttons override background and color together, the unsupported hatch avoids fake paint, and the rose 'converted' tag on paper clears AA (~5.3:1).

accessibility.rationale: Origin buttons use aria-pressed, the verdict is aria-live, every painted state has a text computed read-back, and unavailable states are written out rather than visual-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Harness-validated ok/ok recorded in responsive-support.json (2026-07-24); columns wrap at min-width 240px; this session's own 360px CLI capture is inconclusive due to the headless min-width clamp.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the native side-by-side once alpha() ships
openQuestions.detail: In this Chromium 141 session only the rgb(from …) column runs, so the page's headline comparison (origin-space serialization vs sRGB serialization, and the '✓ native computed value' marker) has never been observed live. When a build with alpha() lands, drive all five origins, confirm the verdict line switches to the differ/match texts, and check the emerald '✓ native computed value' ::after (~4.1:1 on paper) against AA at its 0.72rem size.

summary: The most spec-careful page of the trio: it proves the coordinate-space distinction with real computed values (including out-of-gamut srgb components for wide-gamut origins), keeps the unsupported column honest with a labelled hatch, and resists the temptation to claim visible clipping from string inequality. No defects found; the only open item is exercising the native branch when a shipping build exists. Verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshots, DOM, computed values, clean console); controls not driven in this environment.
